verdict.rationale: Conductor documents bring-your-own-subscription use. Users can sign in to their Cursor subscription for cloud workspaces and choose per organization whether Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor use an API key or a subscription. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the sign-in flow for each agent subscription (evidence is short changelog and pricing lines), and independent or hands-on corroboration of subscription sign-in.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Bring your own subscriptions and keys
